title: Queen to Bee
short_description: A cozy resource management game where you play as the Queen Bee — build rooms, boost honey production, and care for your hive.
description: A cozy resource management game where you play as the Queen Bee. Good decisions for your loyal subjects will go a long way, as well as taking the time to know each and every one! Build cute new rooms and boost your honey production for a healthy hive. Will you be the next Queen?
